name: Grok Build CLI
description: xAI's Grok Build coding agent (binary grok). The official installer runs in a scratch home, and only the grok binary is copied onto the tools volume.
install: mkdir -p {{prefix}}/bin; t=$(mktemp -d) && curl -fsSL https://x.ai/cli/install.sh -o "$t/install.sh" && HOME="$t" GROK_BIN_DIR="$t/bin" bash "$t/install.sh" && cp -L "$t/bin/grok" {{prefix}}/bin/.grok.new && mv -f {{prefix}}/bin/.grok.new {{prefix}}/bin/grok; rc=$?; rm -rf "$t"; exit $rc
upgrade: mkdir -p {{prefix}}/bin; t=$(mktemp -d) && curl -fsSL https://x.ai/cli/install.sh -o "$t/install.sh" && HOME="$t" GROK_BIN_DIR="$t/bin" bash "$t/install.sh" && cp -L "$t/bin/grok" {{prefix}}/bin/.grok.new && mv -f {{prefix}}/bin/.grok.new {{prefix}}/bin/grok; rc=$?; rm -rf "$t"; exit $rc
